body:
## Goal

Fix the guest-name signature overlapping the episode title on carousel cards when an episode has a long title (currently only EP05). The overlap was diagnosed in [PR #77](https://github.com/augmented-mind/augmented-mind.github.io/pull/77): `.card-title` is clamped to 2 lines and EP05's title fills both, running under the absolutely-positioned `.episode-guest` signature.

## Approach (agreed with @XenonMolecule)

Lead with **option 3 — backdrop behind the guest name**: add a subtle rounded backdrop (soft `--light` fill + `backdrop-filter: blur()`) plus `text-shadow` to `.episode-guest` in [`episodeCarousel.scss`](https://github.com/augmented-mind/augmented-mind.github.io/blob/main/quartz/components/styles/episodeCarousel.scss), keeping the change scoped to that selector. Optionally fine-tune EP05's `guestOffset` for alignment. This works for any title length with no per-episode tuning and preserves the floating-signature aesthetic.

## Sequencing / preview

- Branch off the EP5 branch (`agent/implement-issue-75/claude-27244386885`), not `main`, and open the fix PR with **base = the EP5 branch** so the surge.sh deploy preview renders EP5 + the fix together (the only way to verify the long-title card).
- After EP5 (#77) merges to `main`, retarget/rebase this fix onto `main` so it ships immediately after.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Guest signature is fully legible over the EP05 long-title card (no overlap) at desktop (300px) and mobile (260px/240px) widths.
- [ ] No visual regression on ep02–ep04 cards.
- [ ] Change scoped to `.episode-guest` styling (plus optional EP05 `guestOffset`).
- [ ] PR opened against the EP5 branch so the surge.sh preview shows both changes together.

## Context

The user confirmed surge.sh per-PR previews exist (see the preview comment on #77), so no local build is needed to share the result.

---

Requested via pull_request at https://github.com/augmented-mind/augmented-mind.github.io/pull/77

comments.body:
**Sepo implementation finished**

- Branch: `agent/implement-issue-78/claude-27248852159`
- Pull request: https://github.com/augmented-mind/augmented-mind.github.io/pull/79
- Approval: https://github.com/augmented-mind/augmented-mind.github.io/pull/77#issuecomment-4665873011

Fixed the guest-name signature overlapping the title on long-title episode carousel cards (EP05). Added a scoped legibility treatment to `.episode-guest` in `quartz/components/styles/episodeCarousel.scss`: a soft frosted pill (`color-mix` of `--light` at 82% + `backdrop-filter: blur(3px)`) plus a `--light` text-shadow halo, using patterns already present in this repo (search/popover/base SCSS). The change is confined to that one selector — no per-episode `guestOffset` tuning needed, so it holds for any future long title. To make the fix verifiable, the branch was re-pointed onto the open EP5 branch (`agent/implement-issue-75/claude-27244386885`) and the PR base set to that branch, so the surge.sh preview renders EP05 + the fix together. Verified with a full `quartz build` (compiles cleanly) and confirmed the compiled `public/index.css` contains the new `.episode-guest` rules.

---
